note: Reject literal private targets, then validate DNS results in a custom lookup passed to the outbound request so the checked address is the address actually used for the connection. Preserve the absolute target URL when forwarding through an upstream proxy.
before:
? { host: up.host, port: up.port, method: req.method, path: req.url, headers }
: { host: target.hostname, port: target.port || 80, method: req.method, path: target.pathname + target.search, headers };
